511: """WO-S4-WEB-02: build and verify the one versioned Web/ChatGPT mount pack.
512: 
513: This tool is the *only* writer for ``dist/mount/**``. It does three determinism-critical things,
514: and nothing else:
515: 
516: 1. It derives ``MANIFEST.sha256`` **from the actual pack files** (relative POSIX paths, sorted,
517:    ``"<sha256>  <relpath>"`` one per line) and rewrites it into the pack root.
518: 2. It builds the ZIP byte-identically on every run with the same inputs: entries rooted at the pack
519:    directory name, fixed ``ZipInfo.date_time`` (the 1980 ZIP epoch), fixed permission bits, fixed
520:    compression. ``MANIFEST.sha256`` is written **last** (the first manifest entry is therefore the
521:    last archive entry).
522: 3. ``--verify`` recomputes the digest of every manifest-listed member from the ZIP bytes themselves
523:    and refuses, by name, any mutation, missing member, unmanifested member, or path that escapes the
524:    pack root. It never writes.
525: 
526: The tool declares no runtime authority: it is a stdlib-only build/verify utility, candidate-only.
527:

529: ---
530: ``--pack-root DIR --out-zip FILE``   rebuild MANIFEST.sha256, then the ZIP (+ ``.sha256`` sidecar).
531: ``--verify FILE``                    recompute and compare; exit 0 on PASS, non-zero on any refusal.

545: COMPRESS_LEVEL = 9

668:         if manifest_arcname not in names:

/**
 * Whether `modelId` is in a per-provider classification list (e.g. `noVisionModels`). Matches the full
 * id, OR — for Ollama-style ids — the family before the ":size" tag, so a `gpt-oss` entry covers
 * `gpt-oss:120b`/`gpt-oss:20b`. Colon-less ids (e.g. `grok-build-0.1`) still match exactly only.
 */
export function modelInList(list: string[] | undefined, modelId: string): boolean {
  if (!list || list.length === 0) return false;
  if (list.includes(modelId)) return true;
  const colon = modelId.indexOf(":");
  return colon > 0 && list.includes(modelId.slice(0, colon));
}
